entities.name: E. Newton Harvey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Edmund Newton Harvey was an American zoologist. He was acknowledged as one of the leading authorities on bioluminescence. He won the Rumford Prize in 1947 and was a member of the National Academy of Sciences, the American Philosophical Society, and the American Academy of Arts and Sciences in 1929.
